services.name: Eye Clinic
services.desc: Open now at Seattle Children’s Museum, this child size clinic is designed to help kids become more comfortable with going to the eye doctor as well as learn more about eye health and safety. Sponsored by the Optometric Physicians of Washington, Healthy Eyes Healthy People and Luxottica, the eye clinic is just one more way that imagination can come alive every day here at Seattle Children’s Museum. services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Make your child’s next birthday party memorable by letting us host the party for you! You can let the Museum be the entertainment, and leave the sticky finger print clean-up to us. On top of that, your guests receive all-day admission and may attend any of our museum programs! Our themed rooms are ideal for making the day memorable. services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Since 1981, Seattle Children’s Museum has been a treasured institution where generations of families have come to discover, create, and learn together. Our 22,000 square foot space is an ideal location for birthday parties, private and corporate functions, fundraisers, meetings, receptions, and other events. Seattle Children’s Museum is centrally located in the Armory Building on the Seattle Center campus. Our interactive exhibits and engaging environment make Seattle Children’s Museum a great choice for kid-friendly events- and for all who are young at heart!
